label: C2 contingency grounding: power-grounded non-existence, receptivity and the First Way endpoint
summary: Follow-up to PR #1870 (gap 1, next test 3), God-existence stage of the root; note docs/notes/contingency-receptivity-c2.md. Target C2: every being contingent at w is existentially receptive (esse received in a principle in RECEPTIVE_POTENCY_1 to it, or matter and form) or has a distinct SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 CAUSE_2 of its esse. Checked: C2 from power grounding (PGP: contingent beings are corruptible simply or under some power over their esse), correlation (such a power works on a potency to non-being or is a CAUSE_2 of esse), passive-to-receptive, the existing no-self-esse-cause b62a64ab and B3 ee74c678, constructively; unreceivedness of the First Way's mover from simplicity, R3, De ente and receptive irreflexivity, constructively; the First Way's mover necessary (endpoint f9208664) from firstness, unreceivedness and C2 with excluded middle, POTENCY_1 pure act carried and unused; C2 from R1 with De ente and from B2 with B3 (C2 is weaker than both); C2 and its weak form; B2 or B4 (3c9d683b) from PGP, correlation, b62a64ab and corruptible-has-POTENCY_1, which answers #1870 gap 1 conditionally. Reuse decision: the brief's new PotencyForNonbeing primitive is the existing DEF-CAN-FAIL-TO-BE at the respect of being (corruptible simply, In Metaph. IX lect. 9), so PGP connects to B4a and B4b. Findings: #1870's bridge (ii) is false unrestricted (corruptor: power to destroy without causing esse) and holds for incorruptibles from correlation; with adopted POTENCY_1 and the existence-to-act interface B4b excludes every actual corruptible (law 10), so corruptibility is not POTENCY_1 at esse; C2 and B2 or B4 are independent (deistSource, potencyOnly); PGP and C2 are independent of the pure-act target (potencyOnly, angelic), unlike B4; CCR (20babef7) holds in bruteSimple with the contingent simple first being as its uncaused bearer. Models: bruteSimple, selfAnnihilator (two variants), uncausedComposite, angelic, deistSource, bareCorruptible, unprioritizedSource, witness, potencyOnly, corruptor; structural only. truth countermodel does not support CausalityFrame parameters. Duper on C2, the endpoint and B2 or B4: 2 proved (endpoint from the known grounding endpoint; B2 or B4 from R2 with R1, vacuous at actual contingents by the #1870 reception law), C2 unresolved. Provisional judgment: C2 modestly favoured on PGP's general warrant from powers-based modality, its narrowness (actual individuals only), the ordinary cases and Aquinas's corrected channel analysis; standing rival the brute contingent simple first actuality, priced at non-power-grounded de re modality for a foundational individual.
blocker: No premise is established. New OPEN premises: PGP 20d5fecd, correlation 9163c423, passive-to-receptive 16c760a3, corruptible-has-POTENCY_1 8bfc4ab7. Standing rival: a contingent, simple, unreceived, uncaused first actuality under no power (bruteSimple), admissible under modal primitivism or Humean/combinatorial modality. Next tests: (1) PGP against combinatorial contraction of a foundational simple at matching scope; (2) separate conserving from originating power in correlation using the sustaining-causation vocabulary (c94eed5b); (3) passive-to-receptive for a corruptible being without matter; (4) certify the C2/C2-minus strength difference (#1598); (5) assess corruptible-has-POTENCY_1; (6) the q.3 a.7 composition-needs-a-cause bridge for underived beings. Independent semantic challenge pending.
